class.name: rl_locomotion_controller/RLLocomotionController
class.description: Runs an ONNX locomotion policy on the 25-DOF Harambe humanoid. Claims position command interfaces and position+velocity state interfaces for all 25 joints. Subscribes to pelvis+torso IMU and cmd_vel. Outputs targets in CSP mode at 50 Hz (decimation from 100 Hz update).
